note: Deterministic characterization of every (statement property, qualifier property, qualifier-value QID) combination observed on the accepted, unmodified SLICE-0026 retained raw claims for the three shared/qualified Wikidata measurement properties the five allowed fields use (P2043 length: LOA/LWL; P2048 height: draft; P2067 mass: displacement/ballast). Beam (P2049) needs no qualifier disambiguation in the accepted adapter and is excluded. 'recognized'=true means the exact combination is an evidence-backed accepted carrier for an already-accepted concept QID (see hullq.sources.wikidata.QUALIFIER_CARRIERS_BY_VERSION); 'recognized'=false combinations remain unsupported, never guessed.
